subject: Downtime/Large latency spike on 3/16 — goodwill offer and trial extension
messages:
From: Emily Santos <emily@brightcart.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@brightcart.com
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Spike in inference latency impacted checkout flow (3/16)

Hi Jasmine,

We saw a sustained latency spike across our EU region between 08:40-09:20 UTC on 2027-03-16. Several checkout requests timed out for customers and conversion dropped ~5% for the hour. We captured traces pointing to token-generation queuing and saw p99 jump from ~180ms to ~1400ms.

Can Redwood confirm the root cause and whether this will be treated under our SLA? We need a proposal for remediation and any credit/compensation to smooth this with our ops and finance teams. Attaching a snapshot and a short CSV of affected request ids.

Thanks,
Emily Santos
VP Engineering, BrightCart
[attachment: latency-snapshot-2027-03-16.png]
[attachment: goodwill-credit-invoice-stub.csv]
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Santos <emily@brightcart.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spike in inference latency impacted checkout flow (3/16)

Hi Emily — thanks for the heads up and the artifacts. I’m sorry BrightCart hit that. I’ve looped in Dylan (SRE) and Monica (CS) to validate the traces and scope impact.

Proposed immediate steps:
- Dylan: can you confirm whether this was a serving runtime regression or an autoscaler corner case?
- Monica & I: we’ll work through a goodwill package proposal for BrightCart (credits + trial extension) to present to finance.
- I’ll follow up with a single, approved offer to send to Emily and her finance/ops team.

Emily — are you able to share the HubSpot opportunity ID or a quick estimate of monthly token spend so we can size the gesture?

— Jaz
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spike in inference latency impacted checkout flow (3/16)

I pulled the runtime logs for the EU shard. Summary: short lived KV cache thrash combined with a small kernel dispatch delay on a subset of quantized variants when sequence length > 512. Root cause appears to be a rare interaction after a config push (not a code regression) that exposed a sizing edge for our autoscaler for that workload profile. Impact window matches the customer's traces.

Suggested customer-facing remediation:
- Incident write-up (short): explain KV cache thrash + autoscaler sizing, list mitigation steps (we already deployed a hotfix to the autoscaler policy for EU).
- Goodwill: 15k token credit and a 30-day trial/extension (or equivalent billing credit) given BrightCart's high-impact checkout failures.
- Follow-up: SRE-led postmortem with ops contact and a targeted regression test.

Attaching incident summary draft for approval.
[attachment: incident-summary-BR-458.pdf]

— Dylan
Dylan Brooks
SRE, Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 11:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spike in inference latency impacted checkout flow (3/16)

Thanks for the summary. From a commercial standpoint I support a goodwill offer to preserve the relationship. Given BrightCart's ARR profile and the severity (user-facing revenue impact), bump to 20k token credit and a 45-day trial extension. That should be sufficient to cover any short-term impact and demonstrate our commitment.

Ask: Jasmine — if you can get sign-off from Emily on the offer, I’ll route the credit in our billing system and note BR-458 in the invoice memo. Monica, please coordinate the client comms and ensure we capture the redemption window.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed goodwill package for BrightCart (BR-458) — approval requested

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for reporting and for the traces — Dylan’s team confirmed a KV cache/autoscaler sizing edge caused the p99 spikes and we pushed a hotfix to the EU autoscaler within 30 minutes of detection. We’ve attached a short incident summary for your review.

Redwood proposed remedy (approved internally):
- 20,000 token goodwill credit to be applied against BrightCart’s next billing cycle (reference: BR-458)
- 45-day trial extension / redemption window starting 2027-03-19
- Incident summary + SRE contact for any follow-up questions: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai

Attachments: incident-summary-BR-458.pdf, latency-snapshot-2027-03-16.png

If this is acceptable, please reply with a quick approval and I’ll confirm the credit application timeline with finance (Rishi is looped). We aim to have the credit reflected within 5 business days after approval.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
